**Make guard release safe against replacement after the ownership check.**

If a holder’s guard becomes stale, another session can reclaim it after `_guard_is_own` returns but before this `os.unlink`. The unlink then removes the successor’s guard. A third session can enter while the successor still holds its critical section. Coordinate release with reclamation under a stable lock, and test replacement at this exact boundary. Python’s `os.unlink` deletes the file at the pathname, not the file held by `fd`. ([docs.python.org](https://docs.python.org/de/3.12/library/os.html?utm_source=openai))

Based on learnings, checking identity before pathname deletion does not eliminate the TOCTOU race.
